# The Meadow size follow-up changes three branding stylesheets while keeping the image binding

The follow-up changes the nightly, beta and release #codenameLogo dimensions from 28 by 90 to 29 by 113 CSS pixels. The same codenameLogo image, Meadow resource and localization binding remain in use. The accepted source retains these dimensions; enterprise branding remains a separate unchanged size. This is a bounded source phase after the artwork swap, not proof of rendered aspect ratio or a general fixed-size design rule.

Scope: Thunderbird About Dialog Meadow sizing follow-up.
